page.notes: Woodcut ornament at top and decorated initial B beside entries II–III are not text. Handwritten pencil/ink marks in the right margin ("rare", "rare", "rare", "ave", "H3J", "rare") and a bracket beside entries XVI–XX are manuscript annotations, not printed. Scan has show-through and speckles; "Anonymi" and a small mark at the foot are as printed. Some entries are damaged and may be misread: entry XIX/XX numbers, entries XXVI and XXXV page numbers, and the names in XXVII–XXVIII are doubtful. Printed "Digitized by Google" watermark omitted.
